# Observability Requirements Quality Checklist: Unified Commerce Backend

**Purpose**: Assess whether requirements make failures diagnosable through
logs, correlation, audit history, and customer/operator outcomes.
**Created**: 2026-10-21
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist`
command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality
review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the
requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and
satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is
complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK042 - Are logging requirements defined for every failure class: validation, authentication, authorization, concurrency, timeout, dependency, payment, compensation, and persistence? [Completeness, User Input]
- [ ] CHK043 - Does each failure requirement identify the minimum diagnostic context needed to explain what failed, why, and what state resulted? [Gap, User Input]
- [ ] CHK044 - Are correlation-ID propagation, generation, format, lifetime, and inclusion in downstream calls and error responses specified? [Completeness, Constitution §Platform Constraints]
- [ ] CHK045 - Are audit requirements defined for stock, order, payment, refund, cancellation, discount, and administrative changes, including actor and reason? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK046 - Are health and readiness expectations defined for each service and for unavailable downstream dependencies? [Completeness, Constitution §Platform Constraints]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK047 - Is “logs explain each failure” translated into required structured fields such as correlation ID, actor identity, operation, resource, failure reason, and resulting state? [Clarity, User Input]
- [ ] CHK048 - Is the distinction between customer-facing error detail, operator-facing diagnostic detail, and sensitive information explicitly defined? [Clarity, Constitution §III]
- [ ] CHK049 - Are log severity, event names, and whether stack traces or request bodies may be recorded specified? [Gap, Constitution §III]
- [ ] CHK050 - Is “traceable history” defined with retention, ordering, immutability/tamper expectations, and a queryable link between related saga actions? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-018]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK051 - Do correlation and audit requirements use the same identifier vocabulary across services, orders, payments, reservations, refunds, and retries? [Consistency, Spec §FR-018, FR-020]
- [ ] CHK052 - Do security requirements consistently prohibit passwords, tokens, payment details, and other sensitive values from logs while still requiring useful failure explanations? [Consistency, Constitution §III]
- [ ] CHK053 - Do order-state history and failure logs describe the same transition reason and final state? [Consistency, Spec §FR-018–FR-020]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK054 - Can a reviewer objectively determine whether a failure log contains enough information to reconstruct the failed business action? [Measurability, User Input]
- [ ] CHK055 - Are observability expectations measurable for every failure scenario rather than relying on “clear,” “useful,” or “sufficient” logs? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-019, Constitution §Platform Constraints]
- [ ] CHK056 - Are health, correlation, audit, and failure-log expectations tied to explicit service-level acceptance criteria? [Traceability, Gap]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK057 - Are logs and audit records required for both synchronous request failures and background reservation-expiry or recovery actions? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008, FR-020]
- [ ] CHK058 - Are compensation chains required to retain links among the original order, reservation, payment, refund, restock, and final order state? [Coverage, Plan §Order saga]
- [ ] CHK059 - Are duplicate retries required to be distinguishable from first attempts without exposing sensitive request contents? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK060 - Is the phrase “standard business retention and audit practices” replaced with a concrete retention period or explicitly declared out of scope? [Ambiguity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK061 - Is the “next available customer-support action” defined for refused cancellation and other terminal failures? [Ambiguity, Spec §User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK062 - Are requirements explicit about whether metrics, traces, or only logs are required for the first release? [Gap, Plan §Technical Context]

## Notes

- All newly generated items intentionally remain unchecked for reviewer-owned assessment.
- User-specified observability focus incorporated: logs must explain each failure.
- Vague terms explicitly flagged include “clear,” “useful,” “sufficient,” and
  “traceable.”
